user.title: Utility tracker – household
user.description: Name the household. Add utility accounts (electricity, gas) afterwards on the entry.

user.title: New account
user.description: One account = one contract with one meter (e.g. A1 electricity, H tariff, gas).

reszletek.title: Account settings
reszletek.description: Rates start from the provider's official tariff and can be overridden later. Informational only.

data.almero: Irrigation sub-meter behind the main meter

data_description.forras_entitas: A sensor that increases with the meter (with statistics). Manual readings always override it.
data_description.forras_szorzo: If the sensor consistently deviates from the meter (e.g. 1.0412).
data_description.kezdo_allas: Calculation starts here; record later readings with the service.
data_description.forras_tipus: With meter reading the sensor value is the meter itself. With counter only its change is used, aligned to manual readings.
data_description.fizetesi_mod: Partial billing (flat): fixed monthly partial bills, yearly settlement with extra payment or refund. The expected yearly balance is calculated too.
data_description.dijnet_szolgaltato: Payments are read from the Díjnet integration's paid invoices.
data_description.csatornadij_aktiv: Turn off for an irrigation sub-meter.
data_description.forras_tol: Earlier sensor data (e.g. before a formula fix) is ignored.
data_description.napelem_mod: Gross: monthly billing, feed-in credited at the purchase price. Net (szaldó): yearly netting (10 years from commissioning).
data_description.betaplalas_entitas: Suggested from the HA Energy dashboard grid export, if configured.
data_description.almero: Its volume is deducted from the sewage fee (its water is already on the main meter).
data_description.reszszamla_osszeg: HUF; if empty, this or last year's last partial bill.
data_description.elozo_ev_mennyiseg: If there are no two settlement readings.
data_description.szamla_mappa: Inside the config folder, e.g. the Díjnet download folder. New invoices add payments, real meter readings and monthly calorific values.
data_description.szamla_merok: Comma-separated meter serials to split a shared folder (e.g. A1 and H); empty: all invoices belong to this account.
data_description.h_teli_forras: H tariff only. With both registers set, they are measured and billed separately.
data_description.h_nyari_forras: H tariff only, together with the winter register.
data_description.atalany_mennyiseg: If the provider bills a fixed monthly quantity (e.g. 293 kWh): per day × days of the month, priced with the account's tariff.
data_description.elszamolas_honap: How often a settlement invoice arrives.

leolvasas_rogzites.name: Record meter reading
leolvasas_rogzites.description: Manual or provider reading for an account's meter. Always overrides the automatic sensor.

elszamolasi.name: Billing (yearly) reading
elszamolasi.description: Starts the yearly allowance and splits the period here.

csatorna.name: Meter register
csatorna.description: For a bidirectional meter: import or export.

leolvasas_torles.name: Delete reading
leolvasas_torles.description: Deletes all readings of a day from the account.

merocsere.name: Meter replacement
merocsere.description: Closes the current meter and opens a new one; consumption stays continuous.

csatorna.name: Meter register
csatorna.description: For a bidirectional meter: import or export.

feluliras.name: Override rate
feluliras.description: Custom value for a rate or rule from a date. Without a value the override is removed.

naplo.name: Get log
naplo.description: Closed periods, meters, readings and overrides of the account.

csv_export.name: CSV export
csv_export.description: Writes closed periods and readings to CSV in /config/hu_rezsi.

v1_import.name: Import from v1 package
v1_import.description: Copies the old YAML package's reading log and monthly bills. Dry run by default.

futoertek_rogzites.name: Record calorific value
futoertek_rogzites.description: Monthly calorific value from the gas bill (MJ/m³). Without value it is removed.

reszszamla_rogzites.name: Record partial bill
reszszamla_rogzites.description: Manually recorded paid partial bill (without Díjnet).

reszszamla_torles.name: Delete partial bill
reszszamla_torles.description: Delete a manually recorded partial bill of a day.
